digest.component_or_area: live Jira DC harness / inbound provenance test oracle
propositions: The provenance test's substring match against json.dumps(ticket) cannot find the raw Jira key because it is case-sensitive and the local id is lowercased by _jira_key_to_local_id

The ticket payload does not carry the raw Jira key; it appears only as a title fallback that is absent when a summary is present, while the binding is stored separately and not returned by list_tickets

The test must assert the ticket id matches exactly _jira_key_to_local_id(remote_key) and additionally assert the binding store maps that local id to the remote key to prove the round-trip correspondence

An oracle defect masked the actual inbound creation success; a corrected oracle assertion is required before the headline AC 'an issue created in DC appears in the local store after an inbound pass' can be claimed
